title: MV Heavenly Book 天書 ( Open World Exploration RPG )

posts.author: a481205w
posts.body:
遊戲簡介 / Game Synopsis
EN:
One evening, the protagonist purchased a worn-out book at a secondhand stall.
He never expected that, after casually flipping through it at home,
he would be drawn into the mysterious world of the Heavenly Tome.
In this open-world RPG,
you take on the role of the protagonist himself,
exploring an unknown world filled with endless possibilities.
Once you leave the "Shuiyue Residence," there are no more clear boundaries.
Go wherever you wish.
Fight, embark on adventures, experience unique stories,
or simply wander the martial world at your own pace.
The game blends adventure, battles, story-driven encounters, and lighthearted moments,
allowing players to live freely as a hero, a demon, an ordinary traveler,
or even a carefree wanderer in this vast realm.
中文：
某日傍晚，主角在二手書攤上買到一本破舊之書。
卻沒想到回到家後，只是隨手翻閱，
卻意外被捲入了天書世界。
在這款自由開放式 RPG 中，
你將扮演主角本人，
進入一個未知的世界，進行探索。
當你走出「水月居」之後，
便不再有明確限制，
想去哪裡，就去哪裡，
你可以戰鬥、冒險、體驗劇情，
或隨心所欲地在江湖中遊歷。
遊戲基調融合了冒險、戰鬥、劇情與輕鬆氛圍，
讓玩家能以勇者、惡魔、平凡之人，
甚至是逍遙遊俠的身份，自由探索這片天地。
Spoiler:
遊戲特色 / Features
遊戲特色 / Features
EN:
Alchemy System:
Master the art of alchemy by gathering herbs and crafting powerful elixirs.
Each potion you create is a challenge against fate,
strengthening your abilities and paving the way for new adventures.
煉丹系統：
掌控天地草藥，鍛造屬於你的神丹。
每一劑丹藥皆是對命運的挑戰，
助你提升實力，開啟冒險之路。
Star Chart System:
Guided by the stars, each activation writes a new chapter of destiny.
Your choices within the star chart will shape different paths and futures.
星盤系統：
星辰指引，命運輪轉，
每次開啟星盤，都是命運的書寫，
選擇將引領走向不同未來。
Free Combat System:
Wield your sword and fight alongside companions.
Every battle is dynamic and unpredictable,
resembling a legendary martial tale filled with blades and glory.
自由戰鬥系統：
揮劍出擊，與隊友共戰四方，
每場戰鬥皆充滿無窮變數，
戰場如同仙俠傳奇，刀光劍影。
Story Choice System:
Walk between light and darkness, making decisions from your heart.
Every choice rewrites destiny, leading you toward your own unique path.
劇情選擇系統：
正邪之間，選擇由心，
每一抉擇皆可改寫命運，
無論光明或黑暗，都能踏上屬於你的道路。
Starstone Embedding System:
Gain special abilities through the starstones you choose.
Each embedded stone enhances your power,
granting you advantages in the eternal struggle between good and evil.
星石鑲嵌系統：
根據選擇獲得星石能力，
每顆星石都能增強力量，
在正邪之爭中取得優勢。
Five Elements & Five Spiritual Forces:
Harness the balance of the Five Elements and the interplay of spiritual forces.
Mastery of these powers allows you to dominate the battlefield through clever strategy and counters.
五行屬性與五大念力系統：
五行相生相剋，五大念力互制，
巧妙運用五行與念力剋制，
讓每一場戰鬥盡在掌握。

Sect Introduction: Kongming Sect
Hidden deep inside a mysterious mountain lies the Kongming Sect.
Its architecture is built of brick and wood, simple yet solemn.
Mist surrounds the sect all year round, giving off an otherworldly aura.
It attracts countless seekers of the Way to come and cultivate.
Sect Traits
Disciples of the Kongming Sect specialize in the Art of Telekinesis.
In battle, they can focus their mind into crystals to cast seals and control gravity.
During exploration, they can manipulate gravity to help the protagonist solve mechanisms and venture deeper into hidden realms.
Inner Arts and Ultimate Skills
Inner Art
"Infuse crystals with thought, let water move with the mind, turning into blades that shatter enemy ranks."
Crystal Sphere Techniques
The signature move,
“Bind”: crystal spheres shoot forth, entwined with spiritual leaves, trapping enemies in inescapable restraints.
Psychic Blade Techniques
“Blazing Edge”: a telekinetic blade wreathed in flame, exploding upon impact like a falling star, shaking the battlefield.
Special Support Technique
“Refine”: awakens the source of life, granting the cultivator the power of regeneration.
Ultimate Art
The forbidden art, “Supergravity Mind Crush”:
gathers all mental power, crushing everything like a black hole.
But the price is a moment of crippling weakness…
Conclusion
The power of the Kongming Sect extends far beyond the battlefield.
Within the game, more hidden inner arts and secret techniques await cultivators to discover for themselves.

Haitian Sect
Intro
Deep within an underground labyrinth lies a hidden haven, cut off from the world.
Azure seas and towering mountains surround a pure place of cultivation.
This is the Haitian Sect—a school rooted in the power of nature.
What Makes It Special
Disciples train in nature-based Nian Arts,
wielding wind, fire, thunder, and water for powerful attacks.
On expeditions, their arts can melt lava and break glaciers,
opening new paths for the hero.
Arts & Masteries
Cultivation Method
“Nature spellcraft—like leaves on the wind—
turns the world’s qi into a rain of arrows.”
Staff Arts
The signature “Wild Thunder”
calls down lightning with heaven-and-earth force, splitting the sky in an instant.
Gauntlet Arts
“Mistwater” gathers chill into both palms,
forming ice blades that smash the enemy lines.
Special Support
The secret “Verdant Bloom”
draws the earth’s essence to restore vitality, letting you fight on in danger.
Ultimate Art
The legendary “Azure Tempest Cannon”
unleashes all Nian in one blast—
enough to shake heaven and earth—
but leaves the user briefly weakened afterward.
Final Note
The Haitian Sect’s power isn’t limited to the battlefield.
More undisclosed methods and secrets will appear as the game unfolds—
waiting for you to discover.

Shenlong Sect – Faction Introduction
​
About the Sect: Shenlong Sect​
Deep within a secluded forest lies an ancient martial sect known as the Shenlong Sect.
Legends say that this was once the dwelling place of primordial divine dragons.
Its architecture feels ancient and mysterious, perfectly blended with the surrounding nature—
like a hidden sanctuary untouched by the world.
Sect Characteristics​
Disciples of the Shenlong Sect train in
material-based psychic power
.
They can instantly summon dragon spirits in battle or condense psychic force into spirit swords or ritual staves,
unleashing techniques that combine both offense and defense.
In the game, Shenlong Sect skills significantly enhance the hero’s attack and defense,
making them a symbol of
strength and protection
.
Mind Arts & Signature Techniques​
​
Mind Arts​
“Heavenly Dragon Formation” —
uses psychic power to control flames, drawing fiery formations that burn all intruders.
“Vanlong Sword Art” —
infuses spirit blades with fire energy; the sword lights dance like dragon shadows, swift and unstoppable.
Staff Techniques​
“Dragon Spirit Array”
—the user swings a ritual staff to draw runes,
summoning thunder that sweeps across enemies with overwhelming force.
Spirit Sword Techniques
​
“Heaven-Dragon Rend”
—
the spirit sword, infused with earth-element psychic power,
transforms into a roaring dragon shadow that tears through enemy lines.
“Falling Star Annihilation”
—
the blade scatters into countless crystal-like sword lights, dropping like a meteor shower.
Special Support Skill
​
“Secret Dragon Soul”
—
channels the power of a dragon soul into the body, greatly boosting attack and vitality for a short duration.
Ultimate Art
“Dragon Soul Essence”
—
the supreme technique: infuse weapons with blazing dragon energy to incinerate enemies.
However, the user becomes briefly weakened after its use.
Conclusion​
The power of the Shenlong Sect roars like an ancient dragon—
capable of both protection and destruction.
Within the game, many hidden techniques and secret arts remain undiscovered,
awaiting players to explore them themselves.

Sect Overview – Zidie Sect
​
Sect Overview: Zidie Sect
High above the skies, on drifting floating isles,
lies a mysterious valley filled with dreamlike spirit butterflies.
Countless silhouettes of wings dance through cloud and mist,
casting a scene as if it were a realm of immortals.
This is
Zidie Sect
—
a school of cultivation that trains through
music
and the power of
spirit butterflies
.
Distinctive Features
Disciples of Zidie Sect can use
music
and
mental force
to commune with celestial butterflies,
summoning spirit butterflies to aid them in battle.
In combat, they channel their power through
instruments
or a
spear
,
unleashing versatile attacks that shift across multiple elemental attributes.
During exploration, they harness spirit-butterfly power to solve
music-based puzzles
, revealing secrets hidden from plain sight.
Inner Arts & Signature Techniques
Inner Arts
“Wànxié Guidé Inner Art ”
Using mental force to command butterflies, the practitioner releases the power of earth to bind enemies within the soil.
“Huāmó Yuèyǐng Scripture ”
Linking the spirit spear with celestial-butterfly power, hidden earth energy erupts in an instant.
Instrument Path
The most iconic technique,
“Bīnghuá ”
,
uses celestial butterflies as a catalyst to summon icy spirit power—
it scatters like blooming flowers, freezing the enemy formation.
The legendary
“Celestial Thunder Sigil ”
calls upon the might of thunder beasts. Lightning strikes crash down like a torrential storm, leaving foes with nowhere to escape.
Spear Path
“Hundred-Flower Thrust ”
Celestial butterflies form into a spear; each strike blooms like petals—
swift, shifting, and unpredictable.
“Glazed Flame Piercing Heart Art ”
Condense raging fire at the spear tip, pierce through enemy lines, and strike vital points directly.
Special Support Technique
The secret art
“Celestial Butterfly Phosphor Powder ”
scatters shimmering dust upon enemies, lulling them into sleep within an illusory dream.
Ultimate Secret Art
Zidie Sect’s strongest forbidden technique,
“Spirit Descent ”
,
uses the Butterfly King
Meng Feixue
as a medium to summon
four elemental spirits
into the world at once.
It unleashes catastrophic power in a single outpouring—
but the caster will be left in a state of extreme weakness.
Closing
Zidie Sect is not merely a sect that commands spirit butterflies—
it is a mysterious force that weaves together
music, illusion, and nature
.
Yet its true secret methods and unsolved mysteries still await players to uncover for themselves.

Ten Legendary Relics: Nüwa Stone
​
Nuwa Stone is the sky-mending relic from ancient myth.
It restores what’s broken and creates something new.
Legends say it fuses shattered fragments into a whole.
From that union, a new existence can be born.
In
Book of Heaven
, it appears as a fate-changing relic.
It can turn a desperate moment into a new beginning.
​
Relic Highlights
Nuwa Stone symbolizes
restoration
and
creation
.
It rewards rebuilding, not just destroying.
It blends materials, elements, and spiritual intent.
New treasures emerge through flowing energy.
You don’t rely only on battle drops.
You can forge
one-of-a-kind
creations.
​
Core Systems
• Material Fusion System
Players fuse inside a dedicated UI.
Each choice shapes the result.
• Choose in order:
o Element Orbs: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth
o Will Orbs: Will, Matter, Nature, Spirit, Control
o Materials to complete the fusion
​
• Energy Orb Mechanic
Fusion consumes
Energy Orbs
from the party pool.
They represent shared inner power.
More inner power increases capacity, up to
10
.
Orbs deduct automatically during fusion.
This cost signals spiritual energy spent to awaken the stone.
Every fusion has weight.
​
• Crafting Recipes
Each craft requires all conditions to match.
No shortcuts, only precision.
• Requirements:
o Material quantity
o Required element
o Required will type
Success grants a new item.
Failure leaves only an echo, then you try again.
​
• Immersive Presentation
Orbs glow in rings and orbit in motion.
The scene builds tension fast.
Two orbs spin, collide, and shatter.
A new item is born from the burst.
Particles scatter like sky-mending fragments.
A skip option gives instant results.
​
Gameplay Impact
Nuwa Stone adds meaningful strategy.
It turns loot into choices.
• Loot reuse: materials become crafting keys.
• Sect identity: affinities shape what you can forge.
• Resource management: fight now or craft later.
It feels like cultivation-forging: calculation and trade-offs.
Every gain comes with a cost.
​
A Note from the Developer
We wanted forging to feel personal and fun.
Not just a recipe checklist.
Four dimensions drive every fusion.
Elements, will, materials, and energy all matter.
The animations make each fusion a small rite.
Even failure shows the stone responded.
​
Closing
Nuwa Stone stands for mending and making.
It gives power beyond collecting.
You can combine, refine, and forge your own outcomes.
It becomes the key that rewrites fate.

Ten Legendary Relics: Pangu Axe​
In ancient myth, the Pangu Axe split heaven and earth apart.​
Legend says Pangu swung his axe and cleaved chaos in two.
Sky rose from land, and all things were born afterward.
In the adventure of Tianshu, that power is condensed into this artifact.
It embodies the will to forge a path and shatter obstacles.
Artifact Features​
The Pangu Axe symbolizes breaking through and revealing what was hidden.
It is more than a weapon; it can sever seals between heaven and earth.
Raise it and leap skyward, and divine power descends with you.
It can split massive boulders and uncover maps swallowed by darkness.
Core Functions​
Special Event Animation
When you activate the Pangu Axe, a full sequence plays.
Jump into the air to begin the ritual strike.
Swing the axe downward, gathering momentum and divine force.
The boulder shatters, clearing the way with a thunderous crack.
Yellow and white light flash, with rumbling sound and screen shake.
Break Obstacles
On certain maps, the Pangu Axe can smash rocks, seals, and barriers.
Afterward, a shatter effect plays, and the obstacle stays opened.
It may become a broken gate or a pile of shattered stone.
Unlock the Minimap
After splitting the rock, black fog is removed from the minimap.
It symbolizes opening an unknown path, not just breaking stone.
Exploration Rewards
Each successful use is recorded as your Map Breach Count.
As it grows, you unlock more exploration achievements and hidden rewards.
Impact in the Game​
The Pangu Axe adds ritual to exploration, beyond movement and searching.
Each time a boulder splits, you feel the world change.
Roadblock vanishes → A new passage is revealed ahead.
Minimap unlocks → Your full view becomes clear again.
Story and exploration merge → Artifact power stays tied to your journey.
Exploration feels like more than walking; it feels like world-shaping.
You hold the axe that split heaven and earth, and act.
Developer Note​
The Pangu Axe was inspired by the legend of splitting heaven and earth.
I wanted more than a combat attack; I wanted world interaction.
It should make you feel you can change the environment with a relic.
That is why we built a full, cinematic activation sequence.
Jump upward to start the strike and frame the moment.
Swing the axe, carving a clean line through the air.
Light effects surge, flooding the scene with sacred radiance.
Stone shatters violently, scattering shards as the seal breaks.
The map reveals itself, and the new route becomes visible.
Each use feels mighty, leaving a lasting impression during exploration.
Summary​
The Pangu Axe stands for breaking through and opening the way.
It is a battle weapon, and a key to exploration.
On your journey, this divine axe cuts through the unknown again.
It reveals the road ahead, and makes you the one who opens the world.
Interface Screenshot:​
